title: Special resolution for creditors' voluntary winding up
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Corporate Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every section of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 cited.

parts.why: Company documents carry the company's name, registered address and registration (RC) number, and for resolutions and notices the statutory heading. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: SPECIAL RESOLUTION FOR THE CREDITORS' VOLUNTARY WINDING UP OF THE COMPANY AND THE APPOINTMENT OF A LIQUIDATOR PURSUANT TO {{provisions}}
parts.why: The title and the law relied on. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
At the extraordinary general meeting of the company held at {{meetingPlace}} on {{meetingDate}}, it was resolved that:
#. The company be wound up voluntarily as a creditors' voluntary winding up; and
#. {{liquidator}} be and is hereby appointed liquidator to wind up the affairs and distribute the assets of the company.
parts.why: The resolutions to wind up voluntarily and to appoint the liquidator. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

Resolutions are dated and signed, usually by two directors or a director and the secretary. Always sign and date in the exam, on or before the exam date. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Law relied on
fields.question: Which provisions of CAMA 2020 govern a creditors' voluntary winding up? Check them in the library.
